lambda_variant: none: EC2 Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer

runtime.os: Amazon Linux 2023 (arm64), python3.13 package from the AL2023 repositories
runtime.notes: AL2023 maintenance ends 2029-06-30 (standard support ends 2027-06-30). AL2023 supports python3.13 for the upstream period (October 2029), so the OS date comes first. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2023/ug/python.html

image.source: public SSM parameter /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64, read at every plan
image.install: cloud-init user data: python3.13 and amazon-cloudwatch-agent from the AL2023 repositories, app/ files written by Terraform
image.patch_owner: the team that runs the plans: a new AMI shows as a launch template change, and the apply replaces instances by a rolling instance refresh

instrumentation.logging: one JSON line per request to /var/log/app/app.log, shipped by the CloudWatch agent
instrumentation.tracing: none; the load balancer's X-Amzn-Trace-Id is logged
instrumentation.powertools: not used; Powertools is for Lambda

review: pending: promote status to supported after a person reviews the sandbox evidence
